rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Monitors 8 operational supply chain KPIs including OTIF delivery, fill rate, inventory turnover, and supplier quality. Uses an ensemble of statistical and ML anomaly detectors (Z-score, IQR, CUSUM, Isolation Forest) with weighted voting. Integrates Claude for narrative root-cause explanations and recommended actions. Includes FastAPI backend, Streamlit dashboard, and automated Excel/PowerPoint report generation.
